items.name: Halwa Puri Plate
items.description: Two crisp pooris with sweet suji halwa, chana masala and a pickled onion side. Served until 11 am.

items.name: Anda Paratha
items.description: Flaky layered paratha cooked on the tawa with a fried egg folded in. Comes with chutney.

items.name: Chana Chaat Bowl
items.description: Chickpeas, tomato, onion and cucumber tossed in tamarind chutney and chaat masala.

items.name: Chicken Biryani
items.description: Long-grain rice layered with spiced chicken, fried onions and mint. Served with raita.

items.name: Daal Chawal
items.description: Tarka daal over steamed rice with a salad and a green chilli on the side.

items.name: Chicken Karahi with Roti
items.description: Tomato and ginger karahi finished with green chillies, served with two fresh rotis.

items.name: Zinger Burger
items.description: Crispy spiced chicken fillet, lettuce and house sauce in a toasted sesame bun.

items.name: Veg Club Sandwich
items.description: Three layers of toast with mayo, cucumber, tomato, lettuce and cheese.

items.name: Samosa (2 pieces)
items.description: Golden pastry triangles filled with spiced potato and peas, served with imli chutney.

items.name: Masala Fries
items.description: Thick-cut fries tossed in chaat masala with a garlic mayo dip.

items.name: Doodh Patti Chai
items.description: Strong tea simmered with full-cream milk and cardamom. Served hot in a kulhad.

items.name: Mint Margarita
items.description: Fresh mint, lemon and soda blended over crushed ice. No alcohol.

items.name: Mango Lassi
items.description: Thick chilled yoghurt blended with ripe mango pulp and a pinch of salt.

items.name: Gulab Jamun (2 pieces)
items.description: Soft milk dumplings soaked in warm rose and cardamom syrup.

items.name: Kheer Cup
items.description: Slow-cooked rice pudding with pistachio and almond flakes, served chilled.

items.name: Fudge Brownie
items.description: Dense chocolate brownie warmed on request, with a dusting of cocoa.
